# Rebecca Node 1.8.0

Rebecca Node 1.8.0 applies more inbound and outbound changes at runtime, talks to Xray through the 3x-ui API client on an upgraded xray-core, syncs MASQUE users, and restarts Xray on its own after an unexpected exit. It keeps node operations aligned with Rebecca 1.9.0.

## Highlights

- 🔁 **Runtime hot-apply** — inbound swaps and outbound changes are applied at runtime, like 3x-ui, so Xray keeps running.
- 🧩 **3x-ui Xray API client** — the node uses the 3x-ui Xray API client and ships an upgraded xray-core.
- 🛡️ **MASQUE users** — MASQUE users are synced on the node, and users added while Xray is running are cached with their pass key.
- ♻️ **Self-healing Xray** — the node restarts Xray after an unexpected exit and sends gRPC keepalive pings, so the panel notices a dead link sooner.

## Reliability and compatibility

- OpenVPN counts each session's usage once, and a stopped inbound's session records are dropped.
- The HAProxy templates directory is created before a website template is extracted.
- Dev binary uploads retry on transient GitHub errors.
- No configuration, certificate or database changes are needed.

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together, and install Rebecca Node 1.8.0 with Rebecca 1.9.0. Nodes on 1.7.1 can update in place, and no configuration changes are needed.
